partial_summary.scope: Incomplete fixed-source k4 sample; neither this 30-case nor combined 40-case value is the required full-100 mean.

limitations: A single cold-process observation per case; OS file caches and ordinary background loads uncontrolled.
Wrapper wall includes process launch, wait and durable launch bookkeeping; external E0 is separate.
Preflight preparation and postprocessing are outside solver wall and separately recorded.
Peak RSS unmeasured; no per-core byte attribution is inferred from COPY duration under shared DDR.
Per-pipe busy/idle uses final saved intervals and does not establish a bottleneck cause.
Combined R4+A uses the same solver commit and disjoint cases; B/C remain unmeasured here.
